summary.result: The main objective of this study was to suggest a methodology to estimate the flood vulnerability using Potential Flood Damage (PFD) concept.
summary.background: Recently, flood has been increased due to climate change resulting in numerous damages for humans and properties.
summary.method: The three flood vulnerability indices of $F_{DT}$ , $F_{DP}$ and $F_{PA}$ were applied for the 162 cities and counties in Korea for the pattern classification of potential flood damage.
